positions.description:
Versatile Senior Software Engineer (8+ years) with a focus on cross-platform application architecture. I bridge enterprise WPF/C# systems with modern Web technologies and AI-driven data pipelines. Proven expertise in empowering Data Science teams by architecting Python-based automation and integrating results into scalable Web/Desktop environments to streamline internal workflows.

Expert in end-to-end data engineering, transforming complex raw datasets into high-quality inputs for AI-driven insights.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Build new web application for ‘Bernhardt restoration’
•	Work with Angular 2, Bootstrap, HTML/CSS, JQuery

Link: bernhardtrestorations.com

positions.title: C#/ASP.NET MVC DEVELOPER
positions.description:
Part of a team that developed a full stack web applications using ASP.NET MVC, C#, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and AngularJS with an n-tier architecture approach. Included in the applications built are self-designed relational databases, user/admin role management, and salted hashing password encryption for site security.  
•	Built a full-stack E-commerce application for selling bracelets using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular JS, C#, SQL, Bootstrap UI and ASP.NET 4.0.
•	Created and designed wireframe of the website to map out the HTML5 design
•	Enhanced the page layout by implementing CSS3 and Bootstrap UI techniques to the application
•	Worked with Web API to allow website to access information stored in the database
•	Created MVC API tied with windows service
•	Used Entity Framework to replace ADO.Net to automate database related activates
•	Use AngluarJS Http services to retrieve data from API and pass to model
•	Perform UX testing of the products in controlled, real situations before going live to ensure usability of mobile websites. 
•	Designed a normalized relational database using SQL Server 2014
